record.title: Win Streak System AKA Nathan's Treasure AKA Nathan's Booty
Improve Clarity of the "collectable" state of the hourly collection feature
record.description:
The hourly collection feature, when ready to be collected, doesn't clearly explain that the players can collect the hourly. We would like to improve this functionality by adding "collect" text to the button for all three collectable states.

* When hourly collect is ready to be collected at the base state
* When bonus collections is ready
  *  without ad-iap is active, then the bonus collect of that hour can be collected if player watches an ad
  * with ad-iap is active, then the bonus collect of that hour can be collected for free. Please see the screenshots for reference. 

For the "collect" text on the button, we need to localize to spanish before rolling it out and test it accordingly.

![Domino Delight_Saga No Ad for coins.png]([URL_51760])

record.title: Add Hero Offers to Shop
record.description:
The game currently lacks hero-based offer in the shop because players are not buying pop up offers. So we need to have a hero offer in the shop by giving random hero tokens. 

Static shop offer with different color variants. @Martin.Walsh 

**WIP**

![image.png]([URL_52446])

For that, 

1. Implement Hero Offer items (the items except hero tokens)
2. Implement random token drop chance (only with the unlocked heroes)
3. After successful purchase, trigger the chest animation to show which hero tokens are granted. Something like tavern chest animation. 

[ScreenRecording_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6215]_1.MP4]([URL_52445])

record.title: Submit a new build for DD to App Stores
record.description:
As we put the game in the maintenance mode, there are a couple of things I'd like to accomplish

1- Refresh IAP payout list using this list here: [[URL_52550])

We are overly generous with some of the packs - time to jack up the prices 

2- Increase Difficulty beyond chapter 10 - remove 1 starting tile from all levels above chapter 10 - this is on [PERSON_NAME_0092], he is gonna push an update on levels shortly.

3- Turn off Interstitials - would help with retention

4- Fix Lives going to -1. When client displays minus something is really wrong. I'm not sure what triggers it but maybe we can do a patch work and say when client thinks it's minus we set their lives to 5? Let me know how you want to handle this bug.
